name: Shake it Off
text: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your Frightened condition value by 1, and attempt a Fortitude save save to recover from the Sickened condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.
